proposals.evidence: The full haṁsa entry gives Bengali hā̃s and Nepali hā̃s “duck”, alongside Assamese hā̃h and other regional reflexes. These short eastern forms match the hās/ās family, with source palatal-s and loss or absence of written nasalization preserved. Regional contact is not resolved by this family link. The longer haŋos forms and aśkorakī are excluded because the additional material needs separate explanation.
